content:
statusbot: PAGER -> gen-latency eu-west-1. Threshold breached (p95 > 2s) at 2026-03-17T09:00Z. Pager assigned to @maria.

maria: I'm oncall — kicking off logs + genqueue checks. attaching initial stack traces.

alex: seeing backend CPU saturation on mv1 quantized variant, queue growth at the inference layer. possible bad routing of the new quantized model.

maria: confirmed increased retries from router -> starting traffic shift to stable model-v1.2.4 now. will monitor. ETA ~8m.

sam: quick ask from comms — can someone draft an external brief for the status page? need short impact bullets, ETA, and a non-technical root-cause phrase.

alex: short CAUSE line: "recent model variant routing caused higher-than-expected inference latency under certain request shapes". Avoid internal kernel names in public copy.

sam: draft status page copy below — please review, comment inline.

```
Component: Generation API (eu-west-1)
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some requests to the Generation API experienced elevated latency and occasional failures. Customers using streaming or long-context requests in eu-west-1 were most likely to be impacted.
Start: 2026-03-17T09:00Z
Current: We're mitigating by routing traffic off a recently routed model variant. Our on-call has initiated rollback and is monitoring.
Next update: 09:12Z
Contact: https://redwood.ai/support or support@redwood.ai
```

legal: wording: please remove any SLA numbers and soften to "may have experienced". Also add a link to our status page policy and a generic contact phrase for legal/compliance requests.

sam: updated per legal, removed absolutes. New draft: "Some requests may have experienced elevated latency or transient failures between 09:00–09:09Z. We are continuing monitoring."

tina: CS note — top customers on premium plans should get an ASAP email. I'll prep a template and coordinate with @sam for copy.

maria: rollback complete at 2026-03-17T09:08Z — routing back to model-v1.2.4 finished. p95 latency trending back to baseline in last 2m.

alex: KV cache warmup + backend kernel mismatch amplified the problem for long-context requests (>4k tokens). That explains the tail. we'll include a short mitigation note in post-incident.

sam: publishing sequence proposal: 1) Post Investigating update now (09:05Z). 2) Post Mitigation update when rollback finishes (09:12Z). 3) Post Resolved with RCA + customer impact window (09:30Z). Thoughts? :thumbsup:

tina: +1 — I'll send targeted emails to top 5 customers once we have the 09:12Z update.

legal: confirm: don't claim "resolved" until metrics are stable for 20m. Otherwise OK.

maria: metrics look stable at 09:10Z; continued monitoring. no error spike since rollback.

sam: I'll post the initial "Investigating" now. I'll come back with the 09:12Z draft (mitigation details) for final signoff.

statusbot: ACTION LOGGED: statuspage post created (draft) by sam. timeline set: initial 09:05Z, mitigation 09:12Z, resolved 09:30Z.

alex: follow-up action: block future automated routing of that quantized variant until perf tests added to rollout gate. I'll open a task and assign to infra-team.

maria: filing an incident ticket with timeline + logs. I'll include exact customer request IDs for CS to reference.

sam: thanks all — will post updates as we hit each milestone. closing thread once resolved notice is published.

legal: thanks, keeping an eye for any customer requests.

tina: prepping CS templates now. ping me if you want me to include customer-facing mitigation steps.

statusbot: RESOLVE NOTE (planned): "Resolved — routing rollback completed; customers may have seen elevated latency or transient failures between 09:00–09:09Z. For questions contact support@redwood.ai."

maria: Confirmed final: posting resolved at 09:30Z after 20m stable window.

sam: Published: Investigating at 09:05Z. Will update thread with published URLs once live.
